comment: E1 cell map: which OpenGFX source-sheet region becomes which atlas sprite. box = [x, y] top-left of the 64-wide blue tile box in the source sheet; the crop is 64 wide x 31 tall (the tile) and 1 extra bottom row (sheet row y+31 when it is not blue; the tile's own bottom row is cloned otherwise) so stacked tiles never leave a 1px hole under the diamond tip. anchor is measured automatically at slice time = the bottom-centre of the keyed content, snapped into the 64x32 cell.

sprites.name: terrain_water
sprites.note: static sea tile (OpenGFX stores one; wave animation is runtime recolor — no anim frames in source)
